data.gender_notes: Majha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ajh', meaning 'to be strong' or 'to strive'. This name evokes images of bravery, courage, and determination. The name Majha carries the meaning “Strong, brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majha usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
